metadata.title: MzRecal: Universal MS1 recalibration in mzML using identified peptides in mzIdentML as internal calibrants
metadata.abstract: In mass spectrometry-based proteomics, accurate peptide masses improve identifications, alignment and quantitation. Getting the most out of any instrument therefore requires proper calibration. Here, we present a new stand-alone software, mzRecal, for universal automatic recalibration of data from all common mass analyzers using standard open formats and based on physical principles.
